U_guarded: For every persisted reachable canonical W<=4 state of the frozen guarded machine, either R33 has an authorised terminal/W4 reduction, or an R49H direct exact-DP pivot exists, or at least one R47J candidate is terminal or no-fresh strict-variable-descent with final W<=4.

minimal_counterexample_definition.object: F_star is a lexicographically minimum guarded-OPEN reachable W<=4 state under mu=(V,C,L), where V=#variables, C=#clauses, L=#literals.
minimal_counterexample_definition.warning: Minimality is only over the frozen reachable-state domain. Arbitrary clause deletion, literal deletion, relabelling, or subformula replacement is NOT automatically reachability-preserving and therefore cannot be used as a minimal-counterexample step without a separate closure lemma.

symbolic_source_lemmas_frozen_before_exe.statement: Within R33, TAUTOLOGY_DELETION, UNIT_PROPAGATION_WITH_RECONSTRUCTION_TRACE, PURE_LITERAL_AUTARKY, SUBSUMPTION, and BLOCKED_CLAUSE_ELIMINATION cannot increase maximum clause width. BOUNDED_VARIABLE_ELIMINATION is the only R33 rule capable of creating a wider clause.
Starting from W<=4, if an R33 history first leaves W4, the first width-breaking history record must be BOUNDED_VARIABLE_ELIMINATION.

Every R33 history prefix strictly before the first W4-breaking BVE remains W<=4 and consists entirely of existing exact proof-carrying R33 rules. If the breaking BVE is not the first record, a nonempty exact W4-safe progress prefix exists, even though the current guarded controller rejects the full escaped R33 proposal as one batch.

No canonical W<=4 guarded-OPEN state can have V<=5. For V<=5 an R33 W4-domain escape is impossible because any BVE resolvent after eliminating a pivot uses at most V-1<=4 remaining variables; and if R33 is at a fixed point then every present variable is bipolar, while every non-tautological cross-polarity resolvent has width<=V-1<=4, so an R49H direct pivot exists.

For a bipolar pivot v in canonical W<=4, if R49H is unavailable then chi_star(v)>=5; every retained non-tautological width>4 parent pair witnessing this has at least one width-4 parent clause. In an R33 FIXED_POINT guarded-OPEN state this applies to every variable because pure literals are absent.

At V=6, every retained non-tautological width>4 pivot resolvent has width exactly 5 and covers all five nonpivot variables. Its parent-width pattern is only 4x3, 3x4, or 4x4. In 4x3/3x4 the residual variable sets are disjoint; in 4x4 they intersect in exactly one compatible residual literal.

common_obligations: R33 has neither terminal authority nor an authorised full W4 reduction
every R47J pivot is nonterminal and not a no-fresh strict-variable-descent final-W4 successor
R33_FIXED_POINT_CASE: no tautology/unit/pure/subsumption/BCE/BVE rule is applicable under the frozen R33 order
every variable has at least one bad parent pair containing a width-4 parent clause
R33_DOMAIN_ESCAPE_CASE: the first width-breaking R33 rule is BVE
all preceding R33 records remain W4-safe
a nonempty safe prefix may exist but CURRENT guarded semantics does not commit it separately

critical_blocked_proof_step.statement: A classic minimal-counterexample descent cannot discard the R33_DOMAIN_ESCAPE case merely because a smaller W4-safe prefix exists: the current frozen reachable-state relation does not yet grant that prefix independent transition authority. To close this route one must either prove a reachability/authority closure lemma for certified W4-safe R33 prefixes, or prove by another symbolic argument that a minimal guarded counterexample cannot lie in the domain-escape case.

mirrored_falsifier.purpose: Try to falsify the frozen structural lemmas and classify candidate-hard states; it has zero authority to prove U by no-find.
mirrored_falsifier.corpus: Replay the deterministic R50G2 reachable planted-3CNF roots for V=6..10 and a deterministic mixed-width W4 mirror pool; inspect every R33 escape and every state with no R33 authority/no R49H.
required_checks: independently replay every R33 history record and verify final formula/measure
assert any first W4 break is BVE
record safe-prefix length before each escape
for FIXED_POINT/no-R49H states verify bipolarity, chi_star>=5, and width4-parent witness for every variable
for V=6 verify the exact bad-pair geometry
preserve explicit counterexample if any frozen structural lemma fails
